name: Kills in Winter
want: keep the soldiers and their road out of the Powder River country, as Red Cloud has said
secret: His wife's family were among the dead at Sand Creek, and he has sworn privately to kill soldiers until it is paid.
description: A respected fighter of Red Cloud's following among the Oglala, who has fought on the Bozeman road since it was opened.
appearance: A scarred cheek, an eagle feather, a Spencer carbine taken in a fight.
